undocumented.title: Employee List silently exits if department not found
undocumented.code_does: employees.pgm.sqlrpgle returns immediately (without displaying anything or showing an error) if getDeptDetail() reports the department was not found.
undocumented.why_it_matters: A user or caller passing a non-existent department code will see the screen disappear instantly with no feedback, and no specification rule describes this failure mode.

undocumented.title: Stale TODO comment in New Employee program despite working parameter interface
undocumented.code_does: newemp.pgm.sqlrpgle contains a TODO comment saying 'need a way to let the parent program pass in a department id', but the program already declares and uses a currentDepartment parameter via dcl-pi.
undocumented.why_it_matters: The comment is misleading and suggests the department-passing mechanism may have been retrofitted without removing the original note, which could confuse future maintainers about the intent of the code.

undocumented.title: New Employee ID auto-generated as max(empno)+100, not +1
undocumented.code_does: getNewEmpId() selects the maximum integer employee number and adds 100 to it, leaving a gap of 100 ID slots between the last existing employee and any newly created one.
undocumented.why_it_matters: The large increment is undocumented and could rapidly exhaust the 6-digit numeric ID space if called frequently; no specification rule describes the ID generation strategy.

undocumented.title: GetError() validation message for Job field incorrectly reads 'Phone number cannot be blank'
undocumented.code_does: When the XJOB field is blank, GetError() returns the string 'Phone number cannot be blank' instead of a message referring to Job.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This is a copy-paste error in the validation logic that will display a misleading error message to the user when the Job field is omitted.

undocumented.title: F5=Refresh key on Employee List reloads subfile from database
undocumented.code_does: employees.pgm.sqlrpgle handles F5 by calling LoadSubfile(), re-querying the database and refreshing the displayed employee list for the current department.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This refresh capability is not mentioned in any specification rule and represents a functional behaviour that could have UX implications (e.g., unsaved selections are discarded).
